subject: Aligning next steps: ops + ML infra deep dive (60–90m) and attendee list
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@deepsight.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post‑discovery recap + next meeting (ops + ML infra deep dive)

Thanks again for a productive call today — appreciate the clarity on your latency targets and the production constraints for inference (data residency + short‑tail response SLAs). Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

What we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce per‑query cost while meeting 200ms p95 for <512 tokens (user queries)
- Constraints: on‑prem logs retention + internal KMS for keys; legal will want SOC2 artefacts
- Stakeholders: engineering (infra), ops, security/compliance, and product

Suggested next meeting: 60–90 minute technical deep dive (ML + infra + ops) where we: 
1) Walk through proposed deployment options (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and tradeoffs for cost/latency
2) Live demo of a representative inference run + KV cache behavior under burst
3) Review security/compliance touchpoints (KMS, VPC peering, audit logs)
4) Agree on a mutual action plan (owners, data items we need)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 5 — 09:00–10:30 (90m)
- Wed Oct 6 — 09:00–10:30 (90m)
- Thu Oct 7 — 13:00–14:00 (60m)

Suggested attendee roster (we'll bring):
- Ben Carter — Solutions engineer (will run the demo)
- Grace O'Connor — Solutions/ops lead (run runbook, capacity questions)
- Aditya Rao — AE (alignment, mutual action plan)

Would you add the counterparts from engineering and security on your side? I attached a draft agenda and a short mutual action plan so we can prefill owners. If none of these windows work, share 2–3 alternate times and timezone.

Attachments: [TDX‑agenda‑draft.pdf (14 KB)], [mutual_action_plan.xlsx (8 KB)]

Thanks — happy to tighten the agenda once I see your attendee list.

— Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma@deepsight.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@deepsight.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post‑discovery recap + next meeting (ops + ML infra deep dive)

Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. That matches our notes. A couple of updates from our side: 

- I'll loop in our infra lead (Carlos) and our security lead (Maya Patel) — want them on the call for the KMS/VPC discussion.
- Prefer a 90m slot so we have time for the demo + Q&A.

Our availability (PT):
- Wed Oct 6 — 09:00–11:00 (good for us)
- Thu Oct 7 — 13:00–15:00 (also OK)

Can you confirm whether the demo will require any preloaded data or sample logs? Carlos — note you'll be on for the KMS/infra section.

Thanks,
Emma
Head of Product | DeepSight Analytics
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@deepsight.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post‑discovery recap + next meeting (ops + ML infra deep dive)

Emma — perfect. Let's lock Wed Oct 6 09:00–10:30 PT (90m). I'll send the calendar invite after Ben and I confirm the demo footprint. 

Ben — can you own the demo and the pre‑reads? High level ask: a short run showing 1) cold KV load + 2) steady‑state caching behavior and 3) a synthetic burst to demonstrate graceful degradation/fallback to a smaller model. No customer PII required — synthetic payloads fine. Also include an artifact showing expected token cost per scenario.

Carlos / Maya (cc'd by Emma) — if you have a short list of compliance artifacts you want ahead of the call (SOC2 docs, IP allowlist steps, KMS integration diagram), drop them in the Drive link below and we'll include in the pre‑read pack.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3TDX-prereads
Calendar placeholder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=tdx-proposed-slot

Quoting Emma below for context:
> Emma — thanks for the clear recap. That matches our notes. A couple of updates from our side: 
> 
> - I'll loop in our infra lead (Carlos) and our security lead (Maya Patel) — want them on the call for the KMS/VPC discussion.
> - Prefer a 90m slot so we have time for the demo + Q&A.

Thanks,
Aditya
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@deepsight.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 18:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post‑discovery recap + next meeting (ops + ML infra deep dive)

I'll take point on the demo and the pre‑reads. Planned items for the 90m session: 

1) 10m — goals & stakeholder intros
2) 20m — deployment patterns + latency/cost tradeoffs (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
3) 25m — demo: cold start / KV cache / burst behavior (live)
4) 15m — security/compliance integration overview (handed to Grace for runbook items)
5) 20m — Q&A + mutual action plan and next steps

Pre‑reads I'll drop in the Drive folder by EOD Friday:
- short runbook (ops‑checklist.md)
- demo notes + synthetic payloads (demo_payloads.json)
- expected token/unit cost sheet (cost_estimates.csv)

Quick ask: Emma/Carlos — can you confirm whether your infra team prefers AWS PrivateLink or a VPC peering pattern for initial testing? That will change the network slide.

[Attachment stub] — TDX‑agenda‑final‑v1.pdf (will attach to the invite)

Cheers,
Ben — Solutions Engineer
From: Emma Li <emma@deepsight.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@deepsight.io>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@deepsight.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 19:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post‑discovery recap + next meeting (ops + ML infra deep dive)

Great — Wed Oct 6 09:00–10:30 PT works for us. I'll send a calendar invite with Maya and Carlos included. 

To Ben's question: we'll plan for VPC peering for the initial PoC — I'll add the diagram and the list of required firewall rules into the Drive folder. No PII in pre‑reads; we'll share a small subset of anonymized logs if that helps with the demo.

See you all then — appreciate the быстрый turnaround on times.

— Emma
